title: workforce-cc MCP catalog
description: Schema for catalogs/mcp/index.json — declares MCP server configurations recommended for workforce-cc projects.

id.description: Stable identifier; unique within the MCP catalog.

stacks.description: Stacks this server is specifically recommended for. Empty = applicable to any stack.

config.description: MCP server configuration as it would appear in .claude/settings.local.json's mcpServers map.

env.description: Env vars passed to the MCP server. Values may be ${VAR_NAME} placeholders to be resolved from the project's environment.

use_when.description: Bullet list of when to install this server (and optionally when not to).
